title: Double Cross deployment diagram
description: How Double Cross runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and no database. Every browser runs the match; the host's browser decides it, and the games hub relays messages between them.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the Godot web build; one agent per browser. The lowest slot in a match hosts it.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on icelander.net/games/retro/double-cross*, ahead of the games hub's less specific route icelander.net/games/*.

nodes.name: double-cross Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts: the signed-in page and the joined engine; every other path is a static asset from ./dist.

nodes.name: Games hub
nodes.description: The games hub at icelander.net/games: the multiplayer lobby and one WebSocket relay per online match.

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net: who holds the host's site_session cookie and their games: roles. The Worker reaches it only through a service binding.

artifacts.name: Godot web export
artifacts.description: index.html, index.js, index.pck and the engine split into index.wasm.0, .1 (each under Cloudflare's 25 MiB limit).

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: Built and uploaded by wrangler deploy.

relationships.description: Loads the page and the build.
The route sends the game's paths to the Worker.
